name: Fast Dual Contouring
aliases: Dual Contouring with Finite Difference Gradients
definition: A dual contouring algorithm implemented in C++ that generates a mesh from a voxel grid by finding intersections on edges, computing vertex positions via QEF (Quadratic Error Function) minimization, and simplifying the resulting mesh.
summary: Fast Dual Contouring is a real-time surface extraction method that generates manifold meshes from voxel grids by optimizing grid traversal and QEF assembly for sharper feature preservation than Marching Cubes.
